summary: Maase Inc., a Nasdaq-listed PRC investment-advice issuer formerly known as Highest Performances Holdings/Puyi, furnished a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 disclosing that it has terminated negotiations to acquire Shandong Sandi Water Purification Technology Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries, first disclosed in a February 5, 2026 6-K. No definitive or binding agreement was ever executed, so no break fee, financing condition or regulatory clock is implicated. CEO Zhou Min signed the report. The event is a pure deal termination with no purchase price, stake, premium or advisor named. Watch for redeployment of capital, alternative targets and any disclosure gaps around why talks collapsed.
